list.text: Mahogany Town\nHome of the Ninja
Are you off to see the GYARADOS rampage at the lake?
MAGIKARP have returned to Lake of Rage.
That should be splendid news for the anglers there.
Just a Souvenir Shop\nNothing Susposicious about It No Need to Be Alarmed
Mahogany Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Pryce\nThe Teacher of Winter's Harshness
Have you seen this guy with a black cape?
He has been going back and forth between here and the Lake of Rage saying strange radio waves are being transmitted.
Who is he, I wonder.
You should try a yummy RageCandyBar!
Right now, it can be yours for just $350! Want one?

then.text: oh, looks like you don't have enough money, I'm sorry, maybe next time!

else.text: I remember a person from as far as Kanto to buy one a long time ago.
I happened to have none in stock then.\nThat person left rather upset.
I felt kind of sorry for that.

list.text: What? RageCandyBar?\nYou want to buy another?
I think one is enough for you.
\f[faceEusine]\bDid you see that?!
\f[faceEusine]\bSuicune...

[faceEusine] How brave it is!
How refreshing it is!
How beaultiful it is!
And how quickly it moves!
\f[faceEusine]\b\PN!\nYou seem to be around where Suicune would appear.
\f[faceEusine]\bWell, that's OK.\nMy desire to search for Suicune is far beyond yours...
\f[faceEusine]\bMy grandpa was...quite into myths. \nI've heard so many stories about Suicune from him.
\f[faceEusine]\bSuicune...
\f[faceEusine]\bI won't stop following you until I've found out what you're after...
\f[faceEusine]\bYou hear me!
Visit Grandma's shop. She sells stuff nobody else has...
You want to buy stuff, right?\nSo buy stuff at my grandma's!

lines: This event can happenin Mahogany, Olivine or Cianwood - it happens right after the player gets the 7th badge.
